name: Edinburgh 5x5 Day 2027

information: Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. ### This is a specialist side events competition that does not include 3x3. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!
